(2) q_4.9.4s part (ii) solution text itself has a genuine SOURCE-SIDE defect - a 1281 egin{aligned}...1281 block that is missing its own \end{aligned} closer before the block ends (likely an upstream mathpix/extraction artifact, present since stage 1/2 and never caught by any gate since none validate LaTeX balance) - the converters begin-handler was silently dropping the whole  egin{aligned} token and falling through to raw per-character conversion once its search for \end{aligned} failed, turning every bare & in the rest of that block into a literal "&" on the page (5 separate leaks, one per row).
